source: Original lineup screenshot supplied by the owner on 2026-11-13
method: For each piece's board column, measure the first and last rows containing at least three wood-colored pixels whose total RGB difference from the empty-board screenshot is at least 30; red must be at least 1.12 times blue and 1.03 times green. Coordinates refer to pixel centers. Nearby thresholds change the top or bottom by approximately one pixel.
limitation: These are projected image extents, not measurements of the original 3D pieces. The original king image clips the top of its cross.
